Simple quarters in a casual hostel offering a cafe & a bright lounge, plus mountain & valley views.
Within the Spiti Valley, this relaxed hostel in the Himalayan Mountains is 3 minutes' walk from Kaza Bus Stand and 14 minutes' walk from the ornate Sakya Tangyud Monastery.

Simple mixed-gender dorms feature bunk beds, en suite bathrooms and complimentary linens, plus mountain and/or valley views. Private rooms and permanent tents are also available; some basic tents have shared facilities.
Parking is free. There's a cafe, plus a bright lounge with murals and a flat-screen TV. Bike storage is offered, as is breakfast for a fee. Electricity and running water may be limited.

Late review alert : Location - Ek number. We stayed at Zostel Kaza last year in Sept and it has a very beautiful location. We were a group of 3 and were lucky enough to get a room together, and not the typical Zostel experience. Room was decent. The outdoor courtyard and seating for breakfast and dinners was awesome. The food was made more yummy by the stunning scenes around. I also walked right till the river and was very serene (long walk - not recommended as you may get very tired + AMS). Food was decent - but the highlight was being able to talk to so many travellers and hear different stories. The main person at Zostel was also very helpful suggesting us best routes, and latest info about roads, etc.

All in all - worth the money and stunning views.
